title: Забота о маме Лёвы  (Caring for Lyova's Mother)

segments.t: In the storage room, Kostya and Nastya nearly get caught again and pretend the rustling noise was just the kitchen cat. Moments later, Chef Barinov corners Lyova and guilts his sous-chef for never taking his devoted mother out to cultural events.
Нам с тобой нужно серьезно поговорить.
Now let's break down each line of their conversation.
'Wait a second, are you sure that...' Chef Viktor addresses the listener with the informal singular 'you' alongside 'what'. Kostya answers right away.
'Well, of course.' The grammar packs 'come on' and 'of course' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Come on, do not be afraid.' Here the Russian phrasing highlights 'yes' before landing on 'be afraid'.
'I am not afraid at all.' In Russian, the idea of 'yes' flows naturally into 'am afraid' without extra filler words. Kostya answers right away.
'Who is in there?' In Russian, the idea of 'who' flows naturally into 'there' without extra filler words.
'Just our kitchen cat.' Notice how Russian expresses 'come on' and 'our' with crisp inflection rather than helper words.
'Otherwise he will spot us.' Chef Viktor anchors the line on 'and', while 'us' completes the thought. Kostya answers right away.
Нам с тобой нужно серьезно поговорить.
'You and I need to have a serious talk.' The meaning hinges on 'for us' working together with 'to talk' in spoken Russian.
'How could you, Lyova?' Spoken Russian keeps this brisk, leaning on 'what' and finishing on 'Lyova'.
'Why do you neglect your own mother like that?' The negative particle sits right before the verb meaning 'love' to negate the statement. Kostya answers right away.
'What do you mean?' The grammar packs 'sense' and 'sense' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Are you not ashamed of yourself, Lyova?' The grammar packs 'ashamed' and 'Lyova' into a tight, idiomatic kitchen exchange.
'Well, I will take her out sometime.' The meaning hinges on 'come on' working together with 'somehow' in spoken Russian. Now let's put it all back together and hear the whole scene again.
Нам с тобой нужно серьезно поговорить.
When you watch Scene 12 of Episode 15, listen out for the exchange around caring for lyova's mother — you will recognize every Russian phrase right away. See you in the next scene.
